verdict: PORTED + MECHANISM VERIFIED, HOST MOUNT PENDING — the persona now covers the operational discipline layer the upstream prompt has and ours lacked. The new text parses and resolves through the real composition; whether the host serves it to a main agent is a NEW-SESSION question and was NOT claimed here.
theQuestion: Does the orchestrator agent have the 'Sisyphus discipline brain' that cireric-oh-my-dsh-slim's spec claims to adopt?

answerTwoLayers.layer1_againstOurOwnSpec: YES, 4/4. spec §2.1 item 2 lists four brain elements — Phase 0 Intent Gate (surface→intent→routing table + per-turn verbalized routing line + turn-local intent reset + Context-Completion Gate), Implementation Gate (turn-local), delegate-by-domain-and-size-not-by-default, and verification-as-evidence-gate. All four were already present in orchestrator.md, the routing table byte-identical.
answerTwoLayers.layer2_againstUpstreamPrompt: PARTIAL, roughly one third. The upstream prompt carries a further OPERATIONAL discipline layer that our persona lacked (delegation-prompt structure, delegated-result verification, anti-duplication, failure recovery, hard blocks, request-type buckets, completion checklist). That layer is what this round ported.

twoIndependentSources: LOCAL: ~/Project/source/AI/oh-my-openagent, remote git@github.com:code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent.git — git rev-parse v4.19.4 returns the commit above; extracted with git show v4.19.4:<path>.
UPSTREAM: a librarian subagent fetched the same tag over the network; its verbatim text and composition order match the local extraction, and it independently confirmed the same commit.
upstreamVerification.notAsingleFile: The Sisyphus prompt is assembled from sisyphus-dynamic-prompt-{role,exploration,execution,style,sections}.ts via sisyphus-dynamic-prompt-builder.ts in the order renderRoleAndIntentSections → renderExplorationSection → renderExecutionSections → renderToneAndConstraintsSection, plus 12 model-family bodies of 10-32 KB each (sisyphus/claude-*.ts, gpt-*.ts, kimi-*.ts, gemini.ts, glm-5-2.ts, default.ts).
upstreamVerification.policySections: the Hard Blocks / Anti-Patterns / Anti-Duplication text lives in dynamic-agent-policy-sections.ts (6306 bytes at that tag)

ported: Specialists as a 6-column table (Agent | Domain | Delegate when | Don't delegate when | Topology | Mode) — leaf-ness moved off the trailing footnote and onto each row. That footnote/row separation was the direct cause of the round-4 contradiction.

Delegation contract: the five parts every delegation prompt must carry (TASK / EXPECTED OUTCOME / MUST DO / MUST NOT DO / CONTEXT). Upstream's sixth part, REQUIRED TOOLS, was dropped as redundant: each role's tool surface is already fixed by the preset allow-list.

Delegated-result verification: never accept a returned report as evidence; check it works, matches patterns, produced the expected outcome, and respected MUST-(NOT-)DO; on failure return it to the SAME continuable child.
Anti-Duplication rule: once exploration is delegated, do not run the same search; if the next step depends on it, end the turn and wait for the notice rather than polling.
Failure recovery: root causes not symptoms, no shotgun debugging, and the 3-consecutive-failure protocol (STOP → REVERT → DOCUMENT → consult oracle → ASK the user).

Hard blocks (orchestration-specific only, deduped against the global AGENTS.md): never leave a failed attempt broken, never answer while a depended-on delegated result is running, never redo delegated work, never poll a running child, never fire a specialist at a one-line typo.
Step 1 request-type buckets (Trivial / Explicit / Exploratory / Open-ended / Ambiguous).
Phase 3 completion checklist plus 'fix what your changes broke; report pre-existing problems instead of silently fixing them'.
The evidence gate now names diagnostics-on-changed-files explicitly (DSH exposes the official lsp tool).
notPorted: 'Default Bias: DELEGATE. WORK YOURSELF ONLY WHEN IT IS SUPER SIMPLE.' — DELIBERATELY INVERTED by this preset: the spec's §7.2 'do small work yourself' and the persona's 'Small work ... is YOURS' are the intended refinement. The persona now states this divergence so a future reader does not 'fix' it.

task(category=..., load_skills=[...]) / the skills catalogue / the model-core resolution pipeline / ultrawork (RED-GREEN + scenario contract + boulder) — DSH has no equivalent mechanism; the spec's §2.2 already ruled them explicitly out.
The 12 model-family prompt bodies — DSH is pinned to the DeepSeek family.
Tool Call Format section (do not emit tool calls as text) — the DSH transport already handles this.
Todo-management ramping ('OBSESSIVELY TRACK') — the global AGENTS.md and the tool description already govern todo use; restating it would be duplicate prompt weight.

decisions.continuableNotOneShot: cireric-oh-my-dsh-slim spec §2.1(4)/§7.5 said named experts are one-shot (no session reuse), which contradicts the implementation (all four role rows are backgroundMode: continuable and the persona reuses them via send_message). Resolved in favour of the implementation, because upstream Sisyphus carries a MANDATORY Session Continuity rule (NEVER start fresh; 70%+ token saving), making the spec's line the outlier. Both spec lines were updated to match.
decisions.personaTableIsRoutingOnly: The new Specialists table records routing facts only (domain / when to delegate / topology / read-only vs writable) and deliberately carries no tool names: yml allow-lists, the verifier EXPECTED map and the README role table are already three copies of role capability, and this project has been bitten by copy drift twice (README model tiers; the hidden third role registry). Recorded as AGENTS.md pit 11.
